SELECT
    lead.id AS submission_record_id,
    lead.submission_id,
    lead.correlation_id,
    lead.processing_status,
    lead.email_normalized,
    lead.normalized_payload,
    lead.ai_extraction,
    lead.ai_confidence,
    contact.id AS known_contact_id,
    company.id AS known_company_id,
    company.lifecycle_stage AS known_company_lifecycle,
    (contact.id IS NOT NULL) AS existing_contact_match,
    (company.lifecycle_stage IN ('ACTIVE_CLIENT', 'FORMER_CLIENT')) AS returning_client
FROM lead_crm.lead_submissions AS lead
LEFT JOIN lead_crm.contacts AS contact
    ON contact.email_normalized = lead.email_normalized
LEFT JOIN lead_crm.companies AS company
    ON company.id = contact.company_id
WHERE lead.id = $1::uuid
  AND lead.processing_status = 'SCORING';

WITH current_record AS (
    SELECT id, submission_id, correlation_id, processing_status
    FROM lead_crm.lead_submissions
    WHERE id = $1::uuid AND processing_status = 'SCORING'
), updated AS (
    UPDATE lead_crm.lead_submissions AS lead
    SET lead_score = $2::integer,
        qualification = $3,
        scoring_rule_version = $4,
        processing_status = $5,
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM current_record
    WHERE lead.id = current_record.id
    RETURNING lead.*
), review_items AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_crm.review_queue (submission_id, reason_code, reason_detail)
    SELECT updated.id, reason.value,
           jsonb_build_object('score', updated.lead_score, 'qualification', updated.qualification)
    FROM updated
    CROSS JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text($6::jsonb) AS reason(value)
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id
), audit AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_crm.audit_events (
        correlation_id, submission_id, event_type, actor_type, from_status, to_status, event_data
    )
    SELECT updated.correlation_id, updated.id, 'LEAD_SCORED', 'WORKFLOW',
           'SCORING', updated.processing_status,
           jsonb_build_object('score', updated.lead_score, 'qualification', updated.qualification,
                              'rule_version', updated.scoring_rule_version, 'breakdown', $7::jsonb,
                              'relationship_type', $8)
    FROM updated
    RETURNING id
), crm_job AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_crm.outbox_jobs (
        idempotency_key, submission_id, job_type, destination, payload
    )
    SELECT 'crm-sync:' || updated.id::text, updated.id, 'CRM_SYNC', 'hubspot',
           jsonb_build_object('submission_record_id', updated.id, 'qualification', updated.qualification,
                              'relationship_type', $8)
    FROM updated
    WHERE updated.processing_status = 'CRM_SYNC_PENDING'
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id
), notification_job AS (
    INSERT INTO lead_crm.outbox_jobs (
        idempotency_key, submission_id, job_type, destination, payload
    )
    SELECT 'sales-notification:' || updated.id::text, updated.id, 'SALES_NOTIFICATION', 'mailpit',
           jsonb_build_object('submission_record_id', updated.id, 'lead_score', updated.lead_score,
                              'qualification', updated.qualification, 'synthetic', true)
    FROM updated
    WHERE updated.processing_status = 'CRM_SYNC_PENDING' AND updated.qualification = 'HOT'
    ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    'SCORED' AS outcome,
    updated.submission_id,
    updated.id AS submission_record_id,
    updated.correlation_id,
    updated.lead_score,
    updated.qualification,
    updated.scoring_rule_version,
    updated.processing_status,
    $7::jsonb AS score_breakdown,
    $6::jsonb AS review_reasons,
    $8 AS relationship_type,
    (updated.processing_status = 'CRM_SYNC_PENDING') AS should_continue,
    audit.id AS audit_event_id,
    (SELECT id FROM crm_job LIMIT 1) AS crm_outbox_job_id,
    (SELECT id FROM notification_job LIMIT 1) AS notification_outbox_job_id
FROM updated CROSS JOIN audit;
